scope: frozen legacy modules/descriptors and exact active-workflow predecessor text; no runtime acceptance

name: Indexed cbfb finite engineering
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/indexed-schema-finite.yml'
      - 'scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/*cbfb-*'
      - 'packages/backend-mongodb/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  finite-cbfb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['24.x', '26.x']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: .bun-version
      - run: |
          npm ci --prefix packages/backend-mongodb --allow-git=all --ignore-scripts=false
          npm ci --allow-git=all --ignore-scripts=false
          test "$(bun --version)" = "$(cat .bun-version)"
          test "$(bun -p process.versions.typescript)" = "7.0.2"
          bun check -p tsconfig.json
          bun check -p packages/backend-mongodb/tsconfig.json
          npm run build
      - run: node scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-assembly.mjs --profile indexed-schema-all-cbfb-root-native-wire69-engineering-v1 > indexed-cbfb-source.json
      - run: node --test scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-assembly.test.mjs packages/backend-mongodb/tests/indexed-int64-membership.test.mjs
      - run: npm run test:indexed:finite
        env:
          HYPERION_INDEXED_TEST_PROFILE: cbfb
      - run: npm run test:indexed:cbfb:package
        env:
          HYPERION_INDEXED_TEST_PROFILE: cbfb
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: indexed-cbfb-finite-${{ matrix.node }}
          path: |
            indexed-cbfb-source.json
            out/indexed-packed-*/receipt.json
            out/indexed-packed-*/*.stdout
            out/indexed-packed-*/*.stderr
            out/indexed-packed-*/failed.json
          if-no-files-found: error
name: Indexed cbfb native MongoDB engineering
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/indexed-schema-native.yml'
      - 'scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/**'
      - 'src/api/helpers/stateful-owner.ts'
      - 'src/indexer/projection/stateful-*.ts'
      - 'packages/backend-mongodb/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
jobs:
  indexed-native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['24.22.1', '26.4.0']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: .bun-version
      - run: |
          npm ci --prefix packages/backend-mongodb --allow-git=all --ignore-scripts=false
          npm ci --allow-git=all --ignore-scripts=false
          test "$(bun --version)" = "$(cat .bun-version)"
          test "$(bun -p process.versions.typescript)" = "7.0.2"
          bun check -p tsconfig.json
          bun check -p packages/backend-mongodb/tsconfig.json
          npm run build
      - run: node scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-assembly.mjs --profile indexed-schema-all-cbfb-root-native-wire69-engineering-v1 > indexed-cbfb-native-source-${{ matrix.node }}.json
      - run: node --test scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-assembly.test.mjs scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-native-offline.test.mjs scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-native-teardown.test.mjs
      - run: npm run test:indexed:finite
        env:
          HYPERION_INDEXED_TEST_PROFILE: cbfb
      - run: npm run test:indexed:cbfb:package
        env:
          HYPERION_INDEXED_TEST_PROFILE: cbfb
      - run: node scripts/qualification/indexed-schema-mongodb/all-cbfb-native-ci.mjs --profile indexed-schema-mongodb-all-cbfb-linux-gha-v1 indexed-cbfb-native-${{ matrix.node }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: indexed-cbfb-native-${{ matrix.node }}
          path: |
            indexed-cbfb-native-source-${{ matrix.node }}.json
            indexed-cbfb-native-${{ matrix.node }}/
            out/indexed-packed-*/receipt.json
            out/indexed-packed-*/*.stdout
            out/indexed-packed-*/*.stderr
            out/indexed-packed-*/failed.json
          if-no-files-found: error
